title: Evaluator descriptor
description: Optional display object on livingproof-evaluator-result/1.1.0. It describes the evaluator for a generic report. It does not select the scenario or integrity payload. See docs/evaluator-descriptor.md.

title.description: The evaluator's name, used exactly wherever a consumer shows that name. When present it is the same string as evaluator.display_name. Consumers do not append the word evaluator.

short_title.description: A mobile shortening of title that still reads as the same name. It keeps every word, and each word is the start of the matching title word. It is not a different label.

icon.description: Inline SVG. maxLength is 8192 characters. The validator also rejects a UTF-8 encoding longer than 8192 bytes, and enforces the SVG subset in docs/evaluator-descriptor.md. When present, the string equals evaluator.icon.

icon_accessible_name.description: Accessible name for the mark. Recommended when icon is present. Plain text, not an SVG title element.

purpose.description: One or two sentences on what this evaluator judges.

version.description: Evaluator version repeated for the details panel. When present it is the same string as evaluator.version.

kind.description: Display label for the kind of check, as the evaluator states it. Display only. The payload selector is evaluator.kind, which remains scenario or integrity.

source.description: Where the opinion came from, as the evaluator states it. Display only.

tier.description: Default tier for this output. A finding may override it.

success_copy.description: Plain text for the details panel when this evaluator is satisfied.

details_copy.description: Further plain text for the mark's details panel.

grade.description: Optional display percentage from 0 to 100. Strict validation rejects a float, including a zero fractional part such as 100.0. It is not a robot verdict, it does not fold scenario steps, and it is not integrity.run.percentage.

findings.description: Problem entries. Empty or omitted means this evaluator is satisfied for the summary. These are not integrity-check findings.

plain.description: Plain text with at least one visible character. An ampersand is allowed, as in R&D, and is not an entity. Rejects <, >, ASCII and C1 controls, the Unicode line separators U+2028 and U+2029, whitespace-only values, and values made only of Unicode format characters (Cf), including U+FEFF and U+200B. A format character beside a visible character is allowed. Consumers must escape every text field, including &.

tier.description: Line order is verdict, then health_finding, then test_system_status, then review, then observation. Only a verdict finding may change the run verdict ring. This enum is not evaluator.kind.

severity.description: A plain-language severity word or short phrase.

time.description: When in the trial this was observed, as plain text, for example 12.4 s.

trial.description: A trial reference: an integer from 0 to 999999, or a short plain-text reference.

tier.description: Overrides the descriptor's tier for this finding only.

reported_by.description: Plain-text attribution for this finding. The report shows it as the attribution in front of text. Use a role name unless the evaluator output already contains a name.
